relations.text_en: Partnership serving Shake Shack in first class on flights from 13 US airports

source.label: Shake Shack 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our partnership with Delta Air Lines grew meaningfully in 2025, with Shake Shack now served in select routes across flights originating from 13 domestic airports via First Class pre select and supported by strong guest feedback.
